text:
Jason Zucker has played only seven of Buffalo's games, and the start has been rough: one goal, one point, six straight games without a point, and his ice time is down to about 12 minutes. A Markerzone headline also raised an injury concern after a collision with a teammate, though nothing beyond the headline is in our data.

The chances are better than the line. He has 3.04 expected goals from his own shots, a rate (2.14 per 60) that would be among the best in the league, and one goal. His teammates' shooting has also been cold with him on. Our numbers call him due.

He's 34, with 241 goals in 832 games before this season, and he was a 24-goal scorer last year. NHL EDGE has his speed numbers low, which is a concern at his age. Our range expects about 17 goals the rest of the way if he plays. Watch his ice time: if it climbs back, the goals usually follow.
headline: Zucker's chances are there; nothing else is
